items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued August 27 at 11:13AM AKDT until August 29 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow, blowing snow, and periods of wintry mix expected.
Total snow accumulations of 4 to 6 inches expected. Ice
accumulations of a trace to 0.05 inches possible. Wind gusts up to
30 mph possible. Blowing snow could reduce visibility to 1/2 mile
or less at times.

* WHERE...Central Brooks Range.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Friday to 4 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The worst conditions are expected near Atigun
Pass. Elsewhere snow is initially e
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 27 at 10:47AM AKDT until August 28 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds quickly ramp up early Friday morning and
peak around 4 am to 10am. Winds then slowly weaken through the day
Friday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 27 at 10:47AM AKDT until August 28 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 70 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds quickly ramp up early Friday morning and
peak around 4 am to 10am. Winds then slowly weaken through the day
Friday.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Watch for falling debris and tree limbs. Winds this strong can make
driving difficult, especially for high profile vehicles. Use extra
caution.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued August 27 at 8:54AM AKDT until August 28 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels 1.5 to 2.5 feet above the normal high tide
line.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...From 7 PM this evening to 4 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels peak with the Friday morning
high tide and then decrease through the day. The next high tide
after this peak is expected to only be around 1 foot above
normal.
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued August 27 at 8:08AM AKDT until August 28 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...WATER LEVELS AS HIGH AS 1 TO 2 FEET ABOVE NORMAL HIGHEST
TIDE LINE.

* WHERE...KUSKOKWIM DELTA COAST, INCLUDING KIPNUK, KWIGILLINGOK,
KONGIGANAK, AND QUINHAGAK.

* WHEN...FROM 2 PM THIS AFTERNOON TO 4 PM FRIDAY.

* IMPACTS...THERE IS POTENTIAL FOR COASTAL EROSION DUE TO HIGH
SURF. THE COASTAL FLOOD THREAT IS LOW (15 TO 25 PERCENT).

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...PROLONGED STRONG AND GUSTY SOUTH TO
SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS THROUGH FRIDAY EVENING WILL RESULT IN A
BUILD UP OF WAVES ALONG THE KUSKOKWIM
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A HIGH SURF ADVISORY MEANS THAT HIGH SURF WILL AFFECT BEACHES IN
THE ADVISORY AREA, PRODUCING RIP CURRENTS AND LOCALIZED BEACH
EROSION.
